_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd barotrauma/egg-barotrauma.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail passes the game port and an automatic query port on the command line (-port, -queryport; upstream left both at serversettings.xml's 27015/27016), makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server, and adds the barotrauma tag, a working console, generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), install sandbox defaults and resource hints. Console: the server's DebugConsole (BarotraumaServer DebugConsole.UpdateCommandLine) only reads commands with Console.KeyAvailable/ReadKey when neither stdin nor stdout is redirected, and has no RCON, stdin-line mode or command-line switch for it, so upstream's `| sed` colour filter (which redirects stdout and so turns command input off) is dropped: the server runs straight on the container's TTY. There .NET's Console.CursorLeft/CursorTop send cursor position queries (ESC[6n) and block the game's main thread until a terminal answers; the tty_answers flag makes Tentacle answer them on stdin and keep only colours of the escape codes (strip_ansi keeps the persistent log plain). Commands typed in the web console arrive as keys ending in Enter; broadcasts (maintenance countdowns) use `say`, which the server shows as "HOST: …" in the chat. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Barotrauma
author: admin@softwarenoob.com
description: Barotrauma is a 2D co-op survival horror submarine simulator, inspired by games like FTL: Faster Than Light, Rimworld, Dwarf Fortress and Space Station 13. It’s a Sci-Fi game that combines ragdoll physics and alien sea monsters with teamwork and existential fear.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'


# Install packages. Default packages below are not required if using our existing install image thus speeding up the install process.
#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## add below your custom commands if needed

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/DedicatedServer" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Barotrauma dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
